description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema, which manages directives and their defaults within the HTMLPurifier configuration schema. It includes methods for creating instances, adding directives, setting aliases, and serializing/deserializing schema data.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema
classes.description: A class that manages the schema of directives and defaults for HTMLPurifier configuration, allowing for schema creation, modification, serialization, and singleton access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the schema, setting up the default property list.

methods.name: makeFromSerial
methods.description: Deserializes a schema object from a serialized file stored on disk.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the schema, creating it from serialized data if necessary.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Defines a new directive with specified default, type, and null allowance.

methods.name: addValueAliases
methods.description: Adds value aliases for a directive, facilitating multiple values that map to the same setting.

methods.name: addAllowedValues
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed values for a specific directive.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a directive, linking one directive name to another.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Processes the info array to simplify stdClass objects into their type integers or negative types for null-allowing directives.
